titulo: Why Owls Fly in Total Silence
tema: Why can an owl fly in total silence?
estilo_visual: award-winning photorealistic nature photography, soft blue dusk light, shallow depth of field, sharp focus, same barn owl with white heart-shaped face and buff-golden back in every scene

audio.como_ler: picos_cortados.trechos > 0 = distorção; silencios = buraco de 0,7 s ou mais no meio do vídeo; saltos_volume = volume muda 6 LU ou mais em 1 s; voz_abafada = trecho em que a música (ou ruído) preenche os vãos da fala (heurística: confirme pela transcrição)

cenas.narracao: An owl can fly right past you and make no sound at all.
cenas.quadro: Medium-close shot of a barn owl with a white heart-shaped face, buff-golden back and pale speckled chest, perched upright on a mossy branch in a dusk forest, blurred dark trees behind

cenas.narracao: Most birds whoosh when they fly, because air rushing over their wings makes noise.
cenas.quadro: Medium shot of a barn owl with a white heart-shaped face and buff-golden back perched on a mossy branch, dry leaves hanging in the blurred background
cenas.movimento: leaves sway softly in the background

cenas.narracao: But the front edge of an owl feather is soft, like the teeth of a comb.
cenas.quadro: Close shot of the folded wing of a barn owl with buff-golden feathers and fine pale speckles, soft feather edges in sharp focus, dusk forest blurred behind

cenas.narracao: The back edge of every wing is frayed, like a soft fringe.
cenas.quadro: A single buff-golden barn owl feather with pale speckles resting on dark green moss, fine frayed fringe along its edge, dusk light

cenas.narracao: And the feather surface feels like velvet, which swallows the tiny sounds feathers make.
cenas.quadro: Close shot of the soft velvety surface of a buff-golden barn owl feather lying on dark green moss, fine downy texture in sharp focus

cenas.narracao: So the air flows smoothly, and the mouse below hears nothing coming.
cenas.quadro: Medium shot of a barn owl with a white heart-shaped face and buff-golden back perched on a mossy branch, light night mist drifting low in the blurred forest behind
cenas.movimento: mist drifts slowly in the background

cenas.narracao: That is why an owl can fly past you, and the night stays silent.
cenas.quadro: Medium shot of a barn owl with a white heart-shaped face and buff-golden back perched on a mossy branch, deep blue dusk, softly blurred dark forest behind
